title: Deputy Director Site Operations
text:
**About Us**

At Team Housing Solutions, we deliver exceptional temporary lodging services to organizations deploying teams across the United States and globally. We build flexible, on-demand housing solutions by partnering with property owners, asset managers, and third-party providers, driving cost efficiency and operational agility for our clients.

Our mission is to provide superior temporary lodging experiences through streamlined systems, impeccable service, and a collaborative spirit that values our dedicated team, supply partners, and clients alike.

**About the Role**

The Deputy Director of Site Operations is the leader of a dynamic, multifunctional team delivering temporary support facilities to government and private entities for law enforcement, security, undocumented immigrants, emergency evacuations, energy sector workers, and all Team Housing Solutions (THS) clients. The Deputy Director of Site Operations is responsible for ensuring the THS facilities meet THS, industry standards, and client expectations for a comfortable “home away from home” for all THS clients utilizing THS facilities service members and ensuring that the THS facilities are maintained and operating at the highest levels of service. The Deputy Director of Site Operations has a wide range of responsibilities, from financial planning to staff management and client satisfaction. This position requires frequent and significant nationwide travel to THS facilities (including multiple days working at remote facilities for up to 70% of the time), a high level of organizational skills, agility, strong mastery of leadership competencies, and personnel management skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Manage, Lead, and Support the THS Operations Team**

* Provide management oversight of THS facilities’ leadership team in a meticulous manner to maintain THS high-quality standards.
* Provide guidance and direction to facility leadership for the implementation of THS policies and procedures to ensure efficiency and the delivery of quality services to clients.
* Be on-site at the facilities on a regular basis to observe operations and implement improvements.
* In coordination with THS’ HR and leadership, the Deputy Director of Site Operations will recruit, train, develop, and manage each facility team to ensure the client is highly satisfied with THS’ performance levels.
* Establish relationships with clients and obtain regular feedback to ensure high satisfaction levels.
* Ensure compliance with health and safety regulations, industry standards, permitting, and licensing requirements for each facility.
* Develop and implement operational policies and procedures for each facility, including but not limited to logistics, safety, and procurement procedures.
* Address client complaints and ensure client satisfaction through effective problem-solving.
* Identify high-performing employees and see them through professional growth within THS.
* Manage, document, and implement action expeditiously to address the underperformance of direct reports in coordination with leadership and Human Resources to support the business’ needs.
* Regular communication with the VP of Construction & Sustainment to provide updates on the status of operations at each facility. Become a trusted advisor to the VP of Construction & Sustainment by full managing the daily details of all the field facilities, enabling the VP of Construction & Sustainment to develop the operational strategy more effectively.
* Be the link between THS leadership and facilities personnel as a leader, analytical person, and decision maker to improve processes and service quality.
* In coordination with THS leadership, the Deputy Director of Site Operations will interface with Government personnel to address the client’s mission requirements.
* Develop and oversee the implementation of work standards, prepare personnel and project schedules, review work discrepancies, and communicate Government policies, purposes, and goals to all THS’ onsite subcontractors.
* Prepare reports and analyze facilities performance, identify areas for improvement with proposals for implementation of methods for improvements.

**Oversight of Facilities**

* Provide management, direction, administration, documentation, quality assurance, and leadership to THS’ nationwide facilities during the execution of contracts.
* Develop and implement plans and schedules in coordination with THS leadership and clients to expand and contract facilities operations to rapidly address clients’ fluctuating needs.
* Identify and formulate contracting needs for the facilities and coordinate with THS contract management operations to identify qualified vendors and suppliers to meet the facilities’ requirements.
* Prepare budget forecasting for each facility, manage the budget for such operations, and provide monthly detailed budget reports to THS leadership.
* Coordinate with THS’ sales team to identify additional opportunities for THS and assist with presentations to clients.
* Develop community outreach programs to increase THS’ access to the local qualified workforce.
* Develop and implement policies and procedures at each facility to improve efficiency and delivery of quality services.
* Coordinate with THS leaders to assess and mitigate the operational risks at all facilities.
* Establish communication processes and procedures for reporting any incidents at facilities in an expedited manner and resolving such problems.
* Coordinate with the THS contracting team to provide input for new contracting opportunities and logistical requirements for new facility locations.

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university in Business Administration. Hotel Management, or related major.
* Four years of mixed management experience in guest services, front desk, housekeeping, sales and marketing, management operations, or related professional areas with at least two-three years in a managerial or supervisory role.

* Minimum of five years of relevant experience.
* Knowledge of program management tools and procedures.
* Solid leadership and management skills, particularly influence management and conflict resolution.
* Preferred experience throughout the program lifecycle from development through sustainment, including proposal development, requirements decomposition, generation of system and subsystem statements of work and subcontracts, risk management, and continuous improvement efforts, including implementation of cost reduction and performance improvement efforts.
* Preferred experience in finance, contracting, export regulations, engineering, logistics, manufacturing, and supply chain management.
* Excellent customer interface skills.
* Solid critical thinking skills.
* Excellent presentation skills.
* Excellent leadership, oral and written communication skills.
* Project Management preferred (i.e., PMP or equivalent).
* Proficiency in MS Office applications, especially Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and manage sensitive information with discretion.
